data.name: Simulated Field A
data.description: A synthetic 15.5-arcminute field placed near the ecliptic, where solar-system objects are most common. It contains one slow-moving source, one fast mover, one variable source and one detector artifact, so you can practise telling them apart.

provenance.origin: Synthetic field; coordinates are arbitrary and do not correspond to any studied region.
provenance.notes: Synthetic test data that mimics the structure of SPHEREx products. Not a NASA measurement.

meta.notice: Demo mode: responses come from the in-app mock API. SIMULATED DATA. Generated by scripts/generate-mock-data.mjs. Not real SPHEREx observations.
